ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a parallelogram labeled ABCD, with A at the upper right, B at the lower right, C at the lower left, and D on the left side. The length 9 is marked beside side AD; side BC is the side opposite to AD. The figure also marks AB=6, some angles, and an internal line segment, but these pieces of information do not need to be used when finding BC. Reasoning: In a parallelogram, opposite sides are equal. Therefore BC is equal to AD. Given AD=9, so BC=9.
